technical-summary: PWR09 slice 1: PowerTransaction (preflight against fresh probes, durable journal before first write, BDF-ordered apply with exact readback, reverse rollback, restore gated on process exit, journal recovery) and power_receipt (atomic JSON persistence, manifest digest binding); fault-injection tests on a fake amdgpu model.
user-summary-candidate: GPU power settings can now be applied as a safe all-or-nothing transaction with a crash-recovery journal.
